hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: A deadly shooting rampage in Krakow that left six people dead and over a dozen wounded has triggered a fierce political battle in Poland over the gunman's motives. Opposition leader Jarosław Kaczyński and PiS politicians have publicly disputed government assertions of a far-right motivation, accusing ministers of politicizing the attack during a declared period of national mourning.
hotspots.affect: The combination of mass casualty violence and explosive partisan finger-pointing over the shooter's ideological roots creates white-hot affective investment across Polish and international media.

hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Following substantial Republican losses in the midterm elections, internal strife has erupted within the MAGA movement over leadership choices and strategic responsibility. House Democrats led by Hakeem Jeffries are pursuing articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, while prominent Republicans and conservative media figures openly clash over the appointment of Stephen Miller and call for high-level personnel removals.
hotspots.affect: Intra-party civil war combined with immediate threats of impeachment against top cabinet officials generates high-drama coverage centered on vulnerability and betrayal.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Argentina for a high-profile visit, confronting President Javier Milei with direct warnings about the human costs of economic austerity and urging limits on state power. While Milei attempted to present a united front, the stark contrast between papal social teaching and the administration's radical libertarian reforms dominated coverage.
hotspots.affect: A high-stakes moral confrontation between the Vatican's social doctrine and Milei's economic dogma fuels intense ideological debate across Argentine and global outlets.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Scrutiny intensifies surrounding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following his election loss and subsequent departure to the United States. New polling reveals that 62% of Brazilians disapprove of his trip, with majorities perceiving it as an attempt to evade judicial accountability, even as the Bolsonaro family continues to challenge election integrity.
hotspots.affect: The narrative of a high-profile right-wing figure fleeing legal consequences ignites acute outrage from political opponents and defensiveness among loyalists.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Drop Cabinet Demand
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson's decision to drop his party's demand for formal cabinet seats in a future government has sparked debate across the Swedish political spectrum. The strategic concession aims to lure the Center Party into Tidö Alliance cooperation, but it has drawn skepticism from opposition leaders and frustration among grass-roots SD voters.
hotspots.affect: Strategic realignment by a right-wing kingmaker creates significant friction between pragmatism and ideological purity among supporters and adversaries.
